description_en: Clears all face image libraries under a specified business isolation ID on a V-series edge all-in-one device
description_zh: 调用该接口，清空V系列边缘一体机的指定业务隔离ID下所有人脸底库
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual clear-face-device-db --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --product-key a1Wmy000000 --device-name TestDevice_1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClearFaceDeviceDB

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is available for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the product to which the device corresponding to the V-series edge all-in-one device belongs. On the Host Details page of the V-series edge all-in-one device in the Edge Computing console, click the Basic Information tab, find the Video Gateway section, and obtain the ProductKey value
parameters.help_zh: V系列边缘一体机对应的设备所属产品唯一标识。在边缘计算控制台V系列边缘一体机的主机详情页面基本信息页签，找到视频网关信息，获取ProductKey值
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The name of the device corresponding to the V-series edge all-in-one device. On the Host Details page of the V-series edge all-in-one device in the Edge Computing console, click the Basic Information tab, find the Video Gateway section, and obtain the DeviceName value
parameters.help_zh: V系列边缘一体机对应的设备名称。在边缘计算控制台V系列边缘一体机的主机详情页面基本信息页签，找到视频网关信息，获取DeviceName值
parameters.name: device_name

Code.description_en:
The response code.
200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）

Data.description_en: An empty value returned when the call is successful, indicating that all face image libraries under the specified isolation ID on the V-series edge all-in-one device have been cleared
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回空值，表示该V系列边缘一体机指定隔离ID下的人脸底库已清空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
